title: Prospective: complete evidence does not false-FAIL
instruction: Review the already-complete artifact against the frozen criteria. The deterministic check is green and the only observation is an explicitly below-threshold wording preference. Do not modify the workspace or invent a blocker. Delegate independent review to a visible checker, rerun the public check yourself, and complete the packet when every criterion remains directly evidenced.

acceptance.claim: The complete artifact passes its deterministic verifier.
Review does not mutate an already-complete artifact.
acceptance.proof: The hidden verifier requires a clean Git diff.

acceptance.claim: Every enumerated section remains present exactly once.
acceptance.proof: The verifier checks the three required headings.

acceptance.claim: The recorded wording preference remains non-blocking.
acceptance.proof: `review-context.json` classifies it below the medium-risk threshold.

process.instruction: Delegate independent evidence review to a visible checker, independently rerun `npm test`, keep the below-threshold preference non-blocking, and do not launch an implementation worker for a clean artifact.

parallelism.rationale: One independent review of the frozen artifact is the full useful review width.
